Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Secure review intake portal and retention guidance

Team —

We need to lock the secure intake flow and retention guidance for the upcoming review window. Key asks:

- Finalize the wording for the manager-facing instructions that we will link from the portal. (attached: submission-portal-instructions-v1.docx)
- Confirm the retention window for submitted supporting materials and the redaction policy for sensitive fields (attached: redaction-matrix.csv).
- Decide where audit logs will live and who has read access (security/HR ops question).

Timeline: I want a consolidated package ready for the manager pilot by Monday EOD (6/15).

Known constraints: legal prefers a 90-day retention window for attachments but CS has asked for 365-day retention for investigation purposes — we need an explicit tradeoff and signoff flow in the package.

Please respond with edits or +1s inline. If you prefer, add comments directly to the Drive draft I created (link at the bottom of this thread after I get the vendor reply).

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Director, People Programs
Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Secure review intake portal and retention guidance

Rafael —

Thanks for starting this. I made a pass on the instructions doc and attached a short manager comm draft (manager-comm-draft.txt) with plain-language bullets on what to expect. High-level thoughts:

1) Retention: if legal insists on 90 days we can add an exception path for HR investigations where files are escrowed for up to 365 days with two-person approval. That keeps default lean but preserves compliance for escalations.

2) Redaction: the redaction-matrix looks good; recommend we explicitly call out PII types that must not be uploaded (SSNs, passport numbers) and provide a sample redaction checklist for managers.

3) Audit logs: I propose logs live in the HR ops project S3 bucket with read access for HR, Security, and Compliance. We should document the access request process in the appendix.

Question: do we want managers to be able to upload attachments on behalf of employees or require employees to upload themselves? That changes the audit surface.

- Marissa

On Wed, Jun 10, 2026 at 11:22 AM laura.bennett@redwood.com wrote:
> Rafael / Marissa —
> 
> I agree with Marissa's exception path for investigations. For comms, we should include a short FAQ that managers can copy into their 1:1s. I've sketched three Qs in the manager-comm-draft: what to upload, how long it stays, and how to request removal.
> 
> Also: we need a single point of contact for escalation to avoid ad-hoc requests. Suggest naming Legal Escalations / People Ops triage inbox.
> 
> Laura
> VP People Operations
>

+1 to the investigation escrow approach. If we go that route, we'll need a short SLA for approvals (e.g., 48 hours) so managers know when to expect signoff.

Also, question for tech: can the portal automatically strip specified fields from attachments before storage? If not, we need a clear do-not-upload list up front.

Aditya

Thanks all — consolidation below and next actions: 

Summary decisions: 
- Default retention: 90 days for standard supporting materials.
- Investigation escrow: attachments may be escrowed up to 365 days with two-person approval (People Ops + Legal). SLA for approval: 48 hours.
- Managers will be strongly encouraged to have employees upload themselves; portal will allow manager uploads but those uploads will be flagged and require manager justification.
- Audit logs: export to HR ops S3; access roles: people-ops@redwood.com, security@redwood.com, legal-escalations@redwood.com. Requests go to hr-ops-escalations@redwood.com.

Action items (owners):
- Marissa: update manager-comm-draft with FAQ and escalation inbox (due: Mon 6/15).
- Laura: draft short escalation playbook and signoff flow for investigations (due: Mon 6/15).
- Aditya: confirm with infra whether basic field stripping (by mime-type/filename patterns) is supported; if not, add a do-not-upload list to the manager doc (due: Mon 6/15).
- Rafael: confirm retention setting with vendor and schedule manager pilot (I will set portal to 90 days for staging) (done: portal staged, ticket PO-8821).

I've attached the latest redaction matrix and manager comm draft for your final passes. Once we have edits, I will upload to the staging portal and send the pilot invite to a small group of managers.

Thanks — Rafael
